meta.name: memory-index-compact
meta.description: Compact verbose memory index / registry files to pointer-only form. Activate when an index file (index.md, index-decisions.md, or any sibling registry table) breaches the file-size budget OR shows substance-duplication drift. Distinct from memory-compact (which targets content categories) and memory-archive-superseded (which migrates superseded rows to archive).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 压缩冗余记忆索引为精简指针形式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到记忆索引文件超限或冗余问题
copy.tagline_en: Compact verbose memory index files into pointer-only form
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face oversized or duplicative memory index files

howto.what: 当索引文件（如 index.md）过大或字段重复时，Claude 会自动精简每行，只保留路径、ID、状态等关键信息，删除冗余内容，使文件变得更紧凑。
howto.when: 当索引文件超过大小预算（通常 40k 字符），或某行超过 200 字符且包含与源文件重复的内容时自动触发。

say.text: 把 index.md 精简一下，只留指针信息。
压缩 index-decisions.md，移除重复内容。
清理所有索引文件的冗余行。

howto.what_en: When an index file (e.g., index.md) is too large or has redundant rows, Claude automatically compacts each row to pointer-only form, keeping only essential metadata like path, ID, status, and deleting duplicate content.
howto.when_en: Triggered when an index file exceeds its size budget (typically 40k chars) or when a row exceeds 200 chars and duplicates content from source files.

say_en.text: Compact index.md, keep only pointer info.

say_en.note: Claude will process the specified index.

say_en.text: Clean redundant rows in all index files.
